sentences.text:
1 direction upon the respondents to forward the pending reference applications dated 02.08.2010 in Land Acquisition Case No.9 of 2007 filed by the petitioners u/s.18 of the land acquisition act (Annexure-B) to the Hon'ble Reference Court having the jurisdiction to decide/adjudicate the said references.
(B) That this Honourable Court be pleased to pass such other and further orders as NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/10168/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined the nature and circumstances of the case may demand."
2.

Though the petition is filed after a long delay of 12 years from the date of filing of application, but considering the fact about paying just and proper compensation for the land acquired, we dispose of this petition with the following direction:
The respondents are hereby directed to look into the matter and shall pass appropriate orders in accordance with law at the earliest, preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of this order.
However, it is made clear that we have not gone into merits of the matter.
3. The petition is disposed of, accordingly.
